sn35.135:1.1: “Bhikkhus, it is a gain for you, it is well gained by you,
sn35.135:1.2: that you have obtained the opportunity for living the holy life.
sn35.135:1.3: I have seen, bhikkhus, the hell named ‘Contact’s Sixfold Base.’
sn35.135:1.4: There whatever form one sees with the eye is undesirable, never desirable; unlovely, never lovely; disagreeable, never agreeable.
sn35.135:1.5: Whatever sound one hears with the ear …
sn35.135:1.6: Whatever odour one smells with the nose …
sn35.135:1.7: Whatever taste one savours with the tongue …
sn35.135:1.8: Whatever tactile object one feels with the body …
sn35.135:1.9: Whatever mental phenomenon one cognizes with the mind is undesirable, never desirable; unlovely, never lovely; disagreeable, never agreeable.
sn35.135:1.10: “It is a gain for you, bhikkhus, it is well gained by you,
sn35.135:1.11: that you have obtained the opportunity for living the holy life.
sn35.135:1.12: I have seen, bhikkhus, the heaven named ‘Contact’s Sixfold Base.’
sn35.135:1.13: There whatever form one sees with the eye is desirable, never undesirable; lovely, never unlovely; agreeable, never disagreeable.
sn35.135:1.14: Whatever sound one hears with the ear … Whatever odour one smells with the nose … Whatever taste one savours with the tongue … Whatever tactile object one feels with the body …
sn35.135:1.15: Whatever mental phenomenon one cognizes with the mind is desirable, never undesirable; lovely, never unlovely; agreeable, never disagreeable.
sn35.135:1.16: “It is a gain for you, bhikkhus, it is well gained by you,
sn35.135:1.17: that you have obtained the opportunity for living the holy life.”
